name: t-SNE / UMAP
when_to_use: Data with many dimensions (dozens to hundreds of variables); reduce to 2D/3D preserving local neighborhood for visualization, not for downstream modeling.
notes: Reduce many-dimensional data to 2D/3D to see patterns and clusters by eye. Applications: visualize customer or product clusters before running k-means/hierarchical.

expected_input.question: How to visualize in 2D/3D a pattern that only exists in many dimensions?

plain_explanation.purpose: Draws data with many columns on a plane, keeping neighbors together, to see groups.
plain_explanation.when_to_use_plain: When you want to visually explore a complex dataset.
plain_explanation.data_needed: A numeric table with many columns.
plain_explanation.example: See natural clusters of documents or customers on a chart.
